availability.available_at: equals bar_close_ts; modeling convention, not feed-latency claim

eligibility.missing_minute_policy: exclude whole product-day; never synthesize or fill
eligibility.no_trade_intervals: Databento omits intervals with no trades; absence is labeled missing expected published minute and is not asserted to be corruption
eligibility.timing: retrospective whole-day research sample selection known after session end; not a predictive feature or live eligibility signal

limitations: Historical calendar support begins 2015-09-21 for GC and 2021-06-28 for ES/NQ under this fixed-clock specification; earlier product-days remain in the audit but are excluded.
Conservative completeness excludes no-trade minutes as well as any true delivery gaps; missing expected minutes are not by themselves evidence of vendor corruption.
Eligibility is retrospective sample selection and must not be used as a causal live-trading feature.
Adjusted absolute price history incorporates later rolls and is not point-in-time certified or appropriate for execution/P&L.
VWAP is an output-bar HLC3 approximation, not exact trade-price VWAP.
Formula behavior was compared to the Pine HLC3 definition; live TradingView vendor/bar parity was not measured.
